stories.title: Shotton loses its Sayers this weekend as owner moves to shut 19 shops
stories.summary: The Sayers bakery in Shotton will close on Saturday 22 August, staff have told a town councillor, as the chain’s owner proposes to shut 19 shops. stories.title: Reform UK disowns Facebook page named for Alyn and Deeside over Ukraine post
stories.summary: Reform UK says a Facebook page named for Alyn and Deeside and Wrexham is not official, after it carried a post calling for an end to support for Ukraine. The post, published on Monday, described Ukraine as “the most corrupt country on earth” and opened with the line “Old men profit and young men die”.

stories.title: Record five-month bin delay for new Flintshire housing development
stories.summary: Flintshire County Council has been slammed for not providing bin collections for a new Castle Green housing development in Buckley for a record five months. stories.title: Flintshire resident says half her bin collections have been missed by council
stories.summary: A Brynford resident says half of her scheduled black bin collections have been missed by Flintshire County Council since April. stories.title: Director prosecuted after Bagillt waste site repeatedly breached its environmental permit
stories.summary: A former waste company director has been sentenced after a site at Dee Bank Industrial Estate in Bagillt carried on operating after Natural Resources Wales ordered it to stop. Oliver Kirkbride, former director of GTR Aggregates & Recycling Ltd and then Think Aggregates & Recycling Ltd, pleaded guilty and was sentenced on Friday 14 August.
